audience: fundraisers and donor-relations teams who manage donors in Virtuous

useCases.title: Find a donor and read their giving history
useCases.text: The AI finds a contact by name, email or outside reference, lists their gifts and opens one gift with its designations.

useCases.title: Check projects and their giving
useCases.text: The AI searches projects (funds) by name or code and reads balances, financial need and life-to-date giving.

useCases.title: Compare events by RSVPs and giving
useCases.text: The AI lists events with invite and RSVP counts, attendance and total giving, and ranks them for you.

useCases.title: Run a query over gifts, contacts or other records
useCases.text: The AI checks the allowed parameters for a record type, then runs a query on contacts, gifts, pledges, events and more and returns the matching list and total.

useCases.title: Log a note or apply a tag on a donor record
useCases.text: The AI adds a call, meeting or visit note to a contact, using a valid note type, or applies an existing tag to a contact.

useCases.title: Submit a gift or a contact for import
useCases.text: The AI submits a gift or a new or updated contact through the Virtuous import pipeline. A user reviews and commits the import later.
